movimientos.descripcion: La cámara se acerca muy despacio
movimientos.instruccion: Very slow, smooth camera push-in toward the product.

movimientos.descripcion: La cámara se aleja muy despacio
movimientos.instruccion: Very slow, smooth camera pull-back from the product.

movimientos.descripcion: La cámara se desliza un poco hacia un lado
movimientos.instruccion: Gentle lateral camera slide of a few centimeters, product stays centered.
Subtle glints of light moving across the glaze or syrup.
Fine powdered sugar gently falling onto the product.

movimientos.descripcion: Vapor tenue (solo horneados o bebidas calientes)
movimientos.instruccion: Faint wisps of steam rising from the product.
Warm window light slowly shifting across the scene.

prohibiciones: No people, no hands, no faces, no knives or moving utensils, no text, letters or logos, do not change the product's shape, color or decoration, do not rotate the product more than 15 degrees, no new objects that are not in the photo, no camera cuts.
